# Ira Das

A freelance illustrator who draws for children's books, small food brands and editorial pages.

## What the work is

- Ink and gouache, soft edges, a limited palette of four or five colours per piece.
- Subjects: street food, monsoon, grandmothers, small animals in big cities.
- Open for book covers, packaging and editorial commissions.

## Look

- Her own drawings lead every post. No templates over the art.
- Colours: ochre, teal, brick red, cream.

## Never

- AI-generated art presented as her own hand.
- Free work "for exposure".
